item.title: Top business frameworks
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Top business frameworks
1. SWOT Analysis
Used to identify & analyze the Strengths,
Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats of an
organization
How to Use the SWOT Analysis?
Strengths: Evaluate what sets your organization
apart, like skills & resources
Weaknesses: Be aware of them and mitigate them
Opportunities: ldentify market or industry chances
to leverage trends
Threats: Recognize external challenges that could
affect your organization

2. 4P’s Marketing Mix
Helps businesses strategize their offerings in terms
of what a product represents, how it is priced, where
it is made available, & how it is promoted in the
market.
Product: Define what it solves & its unique features,
design, quality, & branding
Price: Decide on pricing strategies considering
costs, competitor pricing, & perceived value
Place: Choose distribution channels and manage
inventory and logistics
Promotion: Craft diverse promotion across ads, PR,
and social media

item.title: [Meeting] Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative
item.author: emecas
item.description:
[Meeting] Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative
Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative

The new Cloud Computing program at Hillsborough Community College, Tampa Florida.

HCC has received a grant from a National Science Foundation, which is providing the funding for development of a new associate of science degree plan and a college certificate program in cloud computing for the college. To support the new programs, HCC is launching a Business and Industry Leadership Team (BILT) model with business and industry experts to align the new curriculum to industry needs and ensure students are prepared for careers in cloud computing.
